test_keep_alive_argument_policy: test the pybind11 keep_alive call policy on method arguments to prevent premature child object deletion
test_keep_alive_return_value_policy: test the pybind11 keep_alive call policy on return values to keep returned child objects alive
test_alive_gc_circular_reference: test garbage collection of ParentGC objects with circular references and keep_alive child policy
test_return_none_keep_alive: test that keep_alive policy safely handles null return values without crashing or leaking
test_call_guard_policy: test pybind11 call_guard policies including GIL release and multiple guard ordering behavior
